title: skills: teach the new action locations vocabulary (list / record + exception words) after #36495
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Blocked-by: #36495

Filing gate: ① follow-up carved from #36495 by the claiming seat (execution-duties: an implementation card's file surface excludes `skills/**`). Source: maintainer rulings on #36495, 2026-11-27 — 7213534162 (start now, before 19.0.0 GA) and 7213827153 (vocabulary confirmed 「照卡上这套」).
Business reason: the published skills are what agents read when they write an app. Once #36495 retires `record_header`, `record_more`, `list_item` and `list_toolbar`, skills that still teach them make every agent-written action use a refused or converted word; authors get a migration warning on code the agent just wrote.
Reader: seat repo:objectstack#3 (card thread at the contract-review tier: `skills/**` is MANDATORY ceiling, Tier H, maintainer or `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` merge).
Dedupe: searched `action locations skills`, `record_header skills`: none open.

## What changes
Teach the new action `locations` vocabulary — `list` (acts on no record) and `record` (acts on one record), with the exception words `record_page`, `record_row`, `record_related`, `record_section` — wherever the published skills and their eval samples teach the old page-part words. Files on origin/main naming an old word (grep, unverified for each hit's meaning): `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, `skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json`, `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`, `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json`, `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`, `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`, `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/record-page.md`.

## Acceptance
- `git grep -nE "record_header|record_more|list_item|list_toolbar" -- skills/` returns only lines that describe the conversion from the old words.
- Eval expected outputs use the new words; skill token ratchets follow the measurement; skills checks pass.
- Lands after #36495 merges, before 19.0.0 GA.
